g.text: fworker refactor (revised 2026-10-26): phases and their tdd gates; tdd switches engines once, as a whole
Stage C Program.cs becomes a composition root
behaviour-neutral steps C-1, C0 .. C8
gate: architecture test; golden writes unchanged; 1 measured batch, no regression;
/ready 200, leader acting, restore ok; 4-hour quiet tdd window
R0 Prerequisites and safety (v1)
aisf off board 679
v1 fixes (fencing, day budget, rev check); quick wins;
flow metrics in the state comment; engine switch per environment
gate: Tier 1 green; 2-hour tdd window, no stage slower
R1 Structure and seams S1 to S3, v1 only
projects (host name kept); first Domain ports + parity tests
S1 verb router, S2 command contracts + recording sink, S3 ingress; verb inventory
gate: golden writes identical (CI)
R2 Wolverine host, tdd in shadow mode
Azure SQL, one replica; Balanced mode, leader election, session mailbox;
background storage setup; OpenTelemetry; dead-letter admin
shadow mode: v2 reads events, commands to the recording sink;
SQL Server in CI; Tier 1 job on v2 with the golden diff
gate: 2-hour window; v2 leading; history for every event;
v1 acts with the database stopped
R3 Durable side effects (v2)
runtime start/stop, runbook runs, journal ledger in C#,
Copilot reservation as integration commands; classified errors
gate: kill scenarios on v2; 2-hour shadow window matches v1's writes
R4 Durable ingress and board reconciler
webhooks and the Octopus watcher into the inbox; correlation map;
board reconciler (or projects_v2_item delivery)
gate: 2-hour shadow window: every board change has its event
R5 DeliveryTrainSaga
ItemMerged from the merge webhook; shadow run against the board
gate: 4 hours or 3 app releases, zero unexplained differences
R6 Docs plan
WorkItemSaga, direct merge in C#; projections
(state comment kept in v1's format for rollback)
gate: docs suites green on v2 with golden writes (CI)
R7 Feature plan
full scheduler, merge train, delivery-speed section 5;
smoke evidence; approved cross-repo pieces
gate: feature suites green on v2 with golden writes (CI)
R9 The rest of v2, then the cutover
QC ported; every verb to its destination (inventory table);
transcripts to the database
tdd switches to v2 as a whole; adoption of open items and Sign-offs;
kill-switch drill (FACTORY_V2_OFF, v1 resumes, back to v2)
cutover gate: 1 measured batch on v2, no regression;
/ready 200, leader, sagas resumed; 4-hour quiet window
R8 Incidents
IncidentSaga, hotfix plan, alert webhooks, rollback via the train
gate: a staged incident in tdd, end to end
R9 v1 removed
remove the sweep engine, server rule scripts, lease, snapshot, shadow mode
gate: 2-hour window; Tier 1 green with v1 gone
